subject: Horizon Telecom — publish checklist & quote sign-off
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@horizon-telecom.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft case story for review — Horizon Telecom

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for agreeing to be a customer story — really appreciate the partnership. Attached is draft v3 of the deployment story (horizon_case_study_draft_v3.docx) and a small performance appendix with the aggregated latency & cost figures we referenced during the POC.

Could you take a look and confirm the following by EOD next Tuesday if possible?
- Accuracy of the deployment timeline (we've listed production go-live as 2026-03-18)
- Approval for the highlighted quote on page 2 (attribution to you is currently: "Priya Shah, VP Technology, Horizon Telecom")
- Any privacy/security edits — we've redacted internal agent names but left product telemetry language at a summary level

If you'd prefer tracked changes, I can push a version with comments instead. Happy to hop on a 30m call if that speeds things up.

Best,
Diego
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0123
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@horizon-telecom.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Cho <evan.cho@horizon-telecom.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft case story for review — Horizon Telecom

Diego,

Thanks for the draft. We reviewed internally and attached a PDF with our redlines (horizon_redlines_2026-07-20.pdf). High-level items:
- Timeline: our cutover was actually 2026-03-22 (not the 18th) — please update.
- Numbers: the latency numbers in the appendix look correct, but the cost savings % on page 3 needs sourcing. Our finance team wants a short footnote about the baseline you used.
- Quote: I like the quote but will tighten the wording. Can you change attribution to "Priya Shah, CTO, Horizon Telecom" (we recently moved titles).
- Security: please remove the sentence that mentions "raw session metadata" and replace with "aggregated telemetry".

We should be able to sign-off once those edits are made and we get a final copy for legal review. I can route to Legal on our side if you send a final PDF.

Thanks,
Priya
VP Technology (acting CTO) | Horizon Telecom
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@horizon-telecom.com>, Evan Cho <evan.cho@horizon-telecom.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft case story for review — Horizon Telecom

Priya — really appreciate the quick review and clear notes. I made inline edits and a small change log (attached: performance_appendix.xlsx has the sourcing details for the cost calculation). Summary of our responses to your points:
1) Timeline: updated to 2026-03-22.
2) Cost %: we added a footnote on page 3 that the baseline was a legacy on-prem routing stack; numbers reflect tokenized inference + infra amortization over 12 months. See appendix for the calculation.
3) Quote: Diego — switching attribution to "Priya Shah, CTO" is fine; Priya please confirm final wording below when you have a moment.
4) Security language: replaced "raw session metadata" with "aggregated telemetry summaries" across all references.

I've also tightened a sentence about SLA eligibility (we removed a stray clause that overstated the committed throughput).

If Priya confirms the final quote text I will produce a clean PDF and send to your legal for sign-off.

Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@horizon-telecom.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Cho <evan.cho@horizon-telecom.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft case story for review — Horizon Telecom

Thanks Monica — the edits look good. Final quote text: "Redwood's inference platform reduced our median API latency by over 40% while lowering monthly inference costs by nearly 30% — a combination that unlocked new real-time features for our customers." Happy with attribution as "Priya Shah, CTO, Horizon Telecom".

One last ask from Legal: can you remove specific dollar figures from the public doc (we'll keep them in a private appendix for vendor diligence)? They flagged two numbers in the appendix. If you send the clean public PDF we'll start legal review and confirm sign-off.

Priya
CTO | Horizon Telecom
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@horizon-telecom.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Final public PDF and publish checklist

Priya — attached is the clean public PDF (horizon_case_study_final_public.pdf) — dollar figures removed from the public doc and retained in the performance appendix. Also included: publish checklist and proposed publish date of 2026-08-03.

Quick checklist for internal Redwood approvals:
- Legal sign-off (Laura)
- Marketing: final hero image and one-line summary (assigned to Laura)
- Product: approve any technical callouts (Marcus)
- Sales: coordinate social amplification and customer quote pull-through (Diego)

Laura — can you confirm legal review by Friday? Marcus — any technical objections to the final language? If none, Priya, we'll route this to your Legal contact this afternoon for final sign-off. Once signed, we'll queue the post on Redwood.com and draft a short joint announcement.

Thanks everyone — excited to get this live.

Diego
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: horizon_case_study_final_public.pdf, performance_appendix.xlsx, publish_checklist.md
